system.description:
Requirements: You must be utilizing Zephyr Style

Cost: 1-2 Focus

The wind curves your missile around whatever your enemy hides behind.

When you make an attack with a Ranged Weapon, you may spend -1 Focus to allow your attack to ignore Light and Heavy Cover.

It may ignore Total Cover so long as you have line of sight to an unobstructed space that has line of sight to your target. If used this way, the attack has Disadvantage.

Enhancement. You may spend an additional +1 Focus when you make this attack: the attack does not have Disadvantage for targeting a creature with Total Cover or a creature within 1 space of you.
